name: statements
note: Two annotated rules, one of them recursive: the innermost commit wins.

name: block
note: A repetition closed by a terminal; the commit is inside a recursive rule.

name: separated
note: Items of a separated list followed by a closing terminal.

name: parameterized-mapping
note: Expanded calls, a token and AST captures: captures stay inside COMMIT.

name: not-inserted
note: @autoCommit on a rule whose failure an enclosing choice can resume inserts nothing: 'ay' stays accepted.

name: group-after-commit
note: A group follows the committed reference: the Java group helpers keep their numbers, so the CST is unchanged (review of #724).

name: whitespace-statements
note: javaStyle (#728): spaces, newlines and both comments between elements; a commit is reported where the committed element starts, after the trivia.

name: whitespace-expression
note: javaStyle: an expression grammar whose operators cannot start trivia; the parenthesised alternative is committed.

name: whitespace-slash
note: javaStyle: '/' can start a comment, so the walk from Term reaches a prefix it does not model and nothing is inserted; 'v // c' stays accepted.

name: whitespace-raw-slash
note: javaStyle: a bare '/' after a bare DIGIT is tried before any trivia is skipped, so it can take the first code point of a comment. '1/**/kx' is accepted as DIGIT '/' and '* * / k x'; committing N after 'k' would reject it, so nothing is inserted.

name: comment-whitespace-statements
note: javaStyle と @comment の併記は javaStyle 単独と同じ挿入・受理・確定エラー位置（#745）。

name: comment-whitespace-expression
note: javaStyle と @comment の併記は javaStyle 単独と同じ挿入・受理・確定エラー位置（#745）。

name: comment-whitespace-slash
note: javaStyle と @comment の併記は javaStyle 単独と同じ挿入・受理・確定エラー位置（#745）。

name: comment-whitespace-raw-slash
note: javaStyle と @comment の併記は javaStyle 単独と同じ挿入・受理・確定エラー位置（#745）。

name: comment-only
note: 終端の先読みは matched だけ進む。COMMIT は CR/LF の手前の consumed 位置（#745）。

name: comment-none
note: 終端の先読みは matched だけ進む。COMMIT は CR/LF の手前の consumed 位置（#745）。

name: comment-only-whitespace-terminals
note: 空白・LF・CRLF は T₀ の外。終端として消費してから cut を入れる（#745）。

name: comment-only-raw-slash
note: 素の / が行コメントの先頭を消費する反例。改行後の N を commit すると 1//c\nkx を拒否してしまう（#745）。
